newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 11.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- U.S. investigators said on Sunday that a computer warning system at Guam airport which could have prevented the deadly crash of Korea Air Flight 801 was out of service at the time.
- With floods and drought threatening a famine, North Korea said Sunday that it wanted to discuss obtaining more food aid before joining a Korean peace conference.
- South Korea will supply $200-300 million as part as a $15 billion fund by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and several Asian nations to support the wailing Baht.
- The South Korean auditor's investigation of the custom's office showed 14 large companies imported $4.1 billion worth of gold bars for immediate export as a means to raise foreign currency.
